title: Amorphous coordination polymers for versatile Mg2+, Ca2+, Sr2+, Ba2+, and Zn2+ cation storage
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02567B, Paper

Xiaolong Guo, Robert Markowski, Ashley Black, Petru Apostol, Darsi Rambabu, Olivera Lužanin, Tjaša Pavčnik, Damien Monti, Mengyuan Du, Da Tie, Xiaodong Lin, Vasudeva Rao Bakuru, Raphaël Delogne, Koen Robeyns, Laura Simonelli, Jean-François Gohy, Jan Bitenc, Jiande Wang, Alexandre Ponrouch, Alexandru Vlad
Amorphous coordination-polymer cathodes enable versatile storage of Mg2+, Ca2+, Sr2+, Ba2+, and Zn2+ without solvent or anion co-intercalation. Delocalized charge and disordered coordination deliver high voltage, low hysteresis, and fast diffusion.
